# dsp-kitchen — GPU Signal Processing & Spike Sorting for Electrophysiology

> dsp-kitchen is a Rust + Python + WebAssembly platform for streaming neural recordings, running deterministic GPU signal pipelines (CubeCL), sorting high-density Neuropixels & HD-EMG data (Kilosort4 with drift correction, EMUsort, MountainSort 5, SpyKING CIRCUS 2, Tridesclous 2), and curating sorted units interactively.

## Quick links

- Docs home: https://neuro-kitchen.github.io/dsp-kitchen/
- Interactive browser viewer: https://neuro-kitchen.github.io/dsp-kitchen/viewer/
- Repository: https://github.com/neuro-kitchen/dsp-kitchen

## Installation

- Python (core): `pip install dspk`
- Python + Synapse sorting/curation: `pip install "dspk[synapse]"`
- Python + Desktop app: `pip install "dspk[app]"`
- Rust CLI & Desktop app: `cargo install dspk-app` / `cargo add dspk`

## Workspaces (App)

- **Explore (`Ctrl+1`)**: Traces and heatmap views of multi-channel recordings, Inspector processing chains with live previews, Processing Quick Start recipes, epochs, and multi-source/recording overlays.
- **Pipeline (`Ctrl+2`)**: Non-destructive GPU processing graph with branching chains and export to `.dspk.zarr`, `.nwb.zarr`, or `.pipeline.json`.
- **Sorting**: Run GPU spike sorters (Kilosort4 with rigid/non-rigid drift correction, EMUsort, MountainSort 5, SpyKING CIRCUS 2, Tridesclous 2) and attach `.sorting.zarr` or Phy outputs.
- **Curation**: Interactive unit table, Affinity left rail, source picker, waveforms, feature projections, auto/cross-correlograms, ISI, amplitude over time, stacked Raster/Traces strip, merge, lasso Split, Unmerge, and Phy round-trip export.
- **Analytics**: Event-aligned PETHs, rasters, and session ledger.

## Spike Sorters (Synapse)

- **Kilosort4 (`dspk-sorter-kilosort`)**: Learned or predefined universal templates, host/device drift estimation and on-device Gaussian kriging correction (`nblocks >= 1`), shared-memory detection kernels, bipartite modularity clustering, matching pursuit, CCG refractory merges (`15.8 s` CUDA / `23.6 s` wgpu on 45 s × 383 ch Neuropixels).
- **EMUsort (`dspk-sorter-kilosort`, feature `emusort`)**: Cross-channel delay estimation/alignment, HDBSCAN outlier rejection, composite quality score (`9.0 s` CUDA / `14.7 s` wgpu on 200 s × 32 ch HD-EMG).
- **MountainSort 5, SpyKING CIRCUS 2, Tridesclous 2**: GPU-accelerated implementations in `dspk-sorter-ms5` and `dspk-sorter-si`.

## Core Python API

- `dspk.open(path)` — open `.bin`/`.cbin` SpikeGLX, NWB, Zarr, or WAV recordings
- `dspk.ops.*` — GPU-accelerated Butterworth IIR, FIR, notch, CAR/CMR, ZCA whitening, Laplacian, resampling, and median filters
- `dspk.Pipeline` — fuse and stream operations over halo windows with exact settling bounds
- `dspk.synapse.*` — probes, detection, feature extraction, sorting, curation, and quality metrics
